-  return total - percent

 }

artifacts.content:
All 4 tests pass now. Two fixes were needed, one per module:

- `lib/cart.mjs` — `cartTotal` summed only `item.price`, ignoring quantity. Now it sums `item.price * item.qty` per line.
- `lib/discount.mjs` — `applyDiscount` subtracted `percent` as a flat amount (`total - percent`). Now it subtracts a true percentage: `total - (total * percent) / 100`.

`node --test` reports `pass 4, fail 0`.
